summary: Local pre-launch exam skill pack that grades a vibe-coded app for leaked keys, auth holes and unsafe deploys.
description: A downloadable skill pack for AI coding agents: eleven diagnostic skills run locally over a vibe-coded repo and produce a graded report with file:line findings — leaked keys, broken auth, missing tests, unsafe deploys, structure and quality — plus remediations the agent can apply. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Cursor Cloud and Grok Bot, and the code never leaves the machine. A free 20-chapter guide on AI coding tools ships alongside.
